author: Murphh
body:
Welcome to the middle ages and my new map, Camelot.  Become a knight of the round table in King Arthur's court and seek the "Holy Grail". Each quad has leather, gold, and limited iron.  The only diamonds on the map are in the middle.  Specialty items include Sir Lancelot's amour, the sword of King Arthur (Excalibur), and Merlin's dark magic. Serf's are available for trades in the middle.

* Updated link for map 03/07/15*
dropbox: https://www.dropbox.com/s/0vtdfn2atv76gkp/Camelot%20upload%201.3.zip?dl=0
imgur:  http://imgur.com/a/fHV3X#0

Feedback is welcome. Thanks for considering!

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body:
Murph:
  • First - I really like the theme of the map! It looks good, and from what I can see was built well. I need a few things done before I can test the map.

  • 1. You have 2 signs that have symbols / odd txt on them under the Keep. please consider correcting those signs.
  • 2. Near the Stable You have an empty Chest
  • 3. On top of the Keep all 4 towers have Lava Buckets, I would like you to consider replacing those. 16 buckets of Lava, in a situation where you are encouraged to build a base on the keep could end up with crazy lag and lava all over the map.
  • 4. The mine only has 54 Iron ore - Would you consider adding more Iron ore? ( the 81 gold ore is fine so is the 0 Diamond Ore ) but with the product mix you have including - Sharp 1 Flame 1 Sword in all 4 quads, the ability for all members  to get at a minimum enchanted Iron armor I feel is a must.
Thanks for letting me look over the map. Please let me know when you have made those changes and I will test the map.

Thanks.

replies.author: Murphh
replies.body:
Polar - Thanks for reviewing the map!  I appreciate the feedback!

1. I will fix those signs that I missed. The weird signs appeared after the quad copy. I tried to fix them all.
2. I will delete those chests. The empty chest was a mistake since I added one inside the stable.
3. I will eliminate some lava buckets. The thought behind the lava was the "murder holes" used during that time period where they would spill hot tar on enemies. I understand lag is an issue. Plus, ap loves lava.
4. I'm still debating the amount of iron on the map.  I wanted a more bare bones map with mostly leather (4 pieces), chain (4 pieces), and gold (mining) as the armor per quad.  Only some players would have iron (mining) pieces. Hopefully, there would be enough competition on the map where one player would not be full iron. There are 4 diamonds in the mid.
There are two flame swords in each quad. One is iron and one is gold.  There is an opportunity to brew a fire resist potion and players can carry water buckets. There is no flame bow on the map.

Are you thinking that one hit from the flame sword while wearing chain/gold armor would do too much damage for a fair fight?  If so, I could change the iron sharp 1 flame 1 sword to gold or stone so the damage isn't so great.

Let me know what you think.  I will work on the other changes.
